verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a distributed professional legal-services firm offering fintech regulatory, venture, IP, privacy and employment counsel, not a software product that a user operates. Operating it through natural-language commands is therefore a category error for this kind of offering. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any software interface, assistant or agentic tooling that would make the axis applicable, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
